items.description: Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor modeling editor services.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorModeling
members.description: Registers the services required by the modeling component group. Also calls AddTempoBlazorDiagramEditor(), because modeling builds on the diagram editor.

items.description: Shows a generated modeling diagram through the diagram editor canvas.

parameters.name: ActiveDraggedElement
parameters.description: Modeling element currently being dragged from the model tree.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: When false, model tree drops are ignored without mutating the preview document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the preview root.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Generated diagram document to show in the preview. Null renders the pre-generation empty state.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the embedded diagram editor reports a document mutation.

parameters.name: OnDrop
parameters.description: Raised when a dragged modeling tree item is dropped onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: OnGenerateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a fresh diagram generation from the currently loaded model.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Raised after a tree element is reused as a new diagram node.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests opening the generated document in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnRelationshipSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a relationship edge is selected in the generated preview.

items.description: Loads a semantic modeling source and presents an initial modeling editor shell.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether model tree elements can be reused by dropping them onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root.

parameters.name: ModelLoaderOverride
parameters.description: Optional loader used by host pages or tests to supply a model without registering a provider.

parameters.name: NotationKey
parameters.description: Optional notation key passed to the selected provider and generator.

parameters.name: OnDiagramGenerated
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model is loaded and converted into a diagram document.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model tree element is reused as a new preview node.

parameters.name: OnNotationChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor notation selection changes.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user opens the generated diagram in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnViewpointChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor viewpoint selection changes.

parameters.name: ProviderKey
parameters.description: Provider key used to select the semantic model provider. Null or empty values render the empty state.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Optional viewpoint key passed to the selected provider and used to choose the initial model view.

items.description: Displays details for a selected modeling element or relationship.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the inspector root.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Selected modeling element. Takes precedence when both element and relationship are supplied.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements used to resolve relationship source and target display names.

parameters.name: Relationship
parameters.description: Selected modeling relationship.

items.description: Displays validation and generation issues for a modeling document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: Issues
parameters.description: Issues to render in severity-coded order.

parameters.name: OnIssueSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an issue that points to a model element or relationship.

items.description: Displays semantic modeling elements grouped by type with live filtering and selection.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the tree root.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements rendered by the tree. They are grouped by SemanticType.

parameters.name: OnElementDragEnded
parameters.description: Raised when the user ends a drag operation from a tree node.

parameters.name: OnElementDragStarted
parameters.description: Raised when the user starts dragging an element node. Reserved for canvas drop support.

parameters.name: OnElementSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an element node.

parameters.name: SelectedElement
parameters.description: Currently selected element.

parameters.name: SelectedElementChanged
parameters.description: Raised when <see cref="SelectedElement"/> changes.

items.description: Shows metadata and reload controls for the modeling data source.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Whether a model load is currently in progress.

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.description: Metadata describing the currently loaded modeling source.

parameters.name: OnLoadRequested
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user requests loading the model again.

items.description: Selects the active modeling notation and notation-specific viewpoint.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the selector root.

parameters.name: NotationKey
parameters.description: Selected notation key.

parameters.name: OnNotationChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the notation changes.

parameters.name: OnViewpointChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the viewpoint changes.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Selected viewpoint key.
